rows.evidence: Q1: Sections 3.2 and 4 - the author builds a fuzzy controller in LabView Fuzzy System Designer and reports simulation runs (Figures 8-14) of greenhouse temperature/air-speed and humidity/irrigation-time control for tulip production in Ilo, Peru.
rows.notes: The study is a pure LabView simulation of a fuzzy on-off controller: it shows that the simulated chiller activates/deactivates around a 15<U+00B0>C setpoint and that irrigation time is assigned by humidity level (Figures 12 and 14). It reports no measurement of water or energy use, no comparison of simulated output with observations from a real greenhouse (the one sentence saying the goals were 'verified during the real-time implementation' is unsupported by any data), and the statements about saving water and energy and reducing crop losses are assertions, not results. Hence no own evidence on the claimed effect of optimized energy and water use; at most it shows the regulation mechanism as a precondition. The paper is largely a literature review plus a programming walkthrough.

notes: Full text appears complete (abstract through bibliography). Figures are referenced but their content is not reproduced in the text; nothing in the text indicates they contain quantitative water or energy results.
